scope: PD-L1 eligibility of first-line pembrolizumab chemotherapy combinations only

observations.finding: Non-squamous NSCLC without sensitizing EGFR/ALK mutations; benefit across PD-L1 categories.
Squamous NSCLC; carboplatin and either paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel; benefit regardless of PD-L1 level.
Combination indications have no TPS >=1% eligibility requirement; chemotherapy partner depends on histology.
Non-squamous pemetrexed/platinum combination excludes EGFR/ALK-positive mutations; squamous carboplatin/taxane combination has no PD-L1 threshold.

open_risks: Separate squamous pembrolizumab regimen and algorithm branch are not yet authored.
This correction does not validate all treatment eligibility or other biomarker records.
